gloss: stuffed to capacity; bulging; packed full

definitions.gloss: stuffed full; bulging; packed to capacity
definitions.explanation: Mimetic word describing something stretched or filled to its limit — a bag packed until it bulges, a stomach so full it is taut, or a schedule with no free slots. Suggests the thing is about to burst or has no more room.

examples.japanese: お{腹|なか}がぱんぱんだ。
{荷物|にもつ}でぱんぱんのバッグ。
examples.english: A bag packed full of stuff.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}がぱんぱんで、どこにも{休|やす}む{時間|じかん}がない。
examples.english: My schedule is packed solid and I have no time to rest.

notes:
Casual mimetic word suggesting maximum capacity or fullness. Used with に + なる (to become stuffed) or as a prenominal modifier.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぱんぱんになる — to become completely stuffed/full
- ぱんぱんに{膨|ふく}らむ — to swell up / bulge
- お{腹|なか}がぱんぱん — stomach is stuffed (after eating)
- ぱんぱんのバッグ — a jam-packed bag

NOTE: ぱんぱん is also used for a light clapping or patting sound (ぱんぱんと{手|て}を{叩|たた}く — to clap), though the 'stuffed full' meaning is more common in everyday speech.
